why.calmness: Outside that one icon, the two cards are pixel-identical, so overall calmness (spacing, color, copy) is indistinguishable.
why.visual_craft: Only one confirmed, deliberate difference exists between the files: 2FC7's '#' is a touch lighter/thinner than B840's, which is a small but purposeful-looking refinement; everything else is identical so this is a marginal edge, not a decisive one.
why.overall: 2FC7 wins on the one confirmed, meaningful difference (lighter decorative hash improving icon hierarchy) with no confirmed regression elsewhere and no lost content, but the margin is small since almost the entire card is pixel-for-pixel the same file.
